page.$description: The root screen canvas, use as every screen's base background, not for cards, sheets or modals.

surface.$description: Elevated container fill, use for cards, bottom sheets, modals, dropdowns and chat bubbles, not page-level background.

inverse.$description: Dark block on a light screen, use for tooltips, toasts and snackbars sitting on light backgrounds.

scrim.$description: Semi-transparent overlay dimming content behind a modal, use behind modals, dialogs and bottom sheets.

floating.$description: Elevated floating surface with translucency, use for dropdown menus, tooltips and popovers with a frosted-glass effect.

stacking.$description: Additive white layer for stacking elevation on dark surfaces, use for toasts and floating notifications needing subtle lift.

input.$description: Fill of an editable field, use for text inputs, textareas and search fields at rest, not for read-only surfaces.

primary.$description: Highest-contrast text, use for headlines, body copy and titles, the default when unsure which text token to pick.

secondary.$description: Reduced-emphasis text, use for subtitles, captions, timestamps and helper text.

inverse.$description: Dark text on light or vivid surfaces, use on background.inverse and bright accent fills.

link.$description: Inline hyperlink text only, not for buttons or nav items.

linkHover.$description: Hover state of text.link, for pointer hover on inline hyperlinks.

disabled.$description: Low-contrast text signaling unavailable or not-yet-filled, use on disabled controls and empty-field placeholders.

tertiary.$description: Lowest-emphasis readable text, use for timestamps, counts and inline hints, never for anything a student must read to proceed.

success.$description: Confirmation text, use for messages like 'Correct', not as a fill.

error.$description: Validation message text, use on the line under a failed field.

warning.$description: Caution text, use for limits and expiry notices like 'one attempt left'.

onAccent.$description: Text sitting on any accent.*.bold fill, must contrast at least 4.5:1 against it.

default.$description: Standard container edge, use for card outlines, dividers and input borders at rest, not for selected elements.

strong.$description: Higher contrast container edge, use for dividers that must read at a glance and rules on busy surfaces.

focus.$description: The visible keyboard focus ring on any focusable element, never remove without a replacement.

error.$description: Invalid input edge, use for text fields and selects that failed validation.

success.$description: Validated input edge, use for fields confirmed correct.

selected.$description: Edge of a chosen element, use for selected cards, active tabs and chosen answer options.

primary.$description: The main call-to-action fill, use for the one primary button per screen, not for selected cards or links.

secondary.$description: Supporting-action fill, use for skip, cancel, filter chips and outlined buttons, not the primary CTA.

destructive.$description: Irreversible harmful-action fill, use for delete, remove and block buttons, not validation errors.

disabled.$description: Non-interactive control fill signaling unavailable, use for disabled buttons, toggles and sliders.

onPrimary.$description: Text and icon color on interactive.primary fills, must contrast at least 4.5:1.

onSecondary.$description: Text and icon color inside secondary buttons, toggles and filter chips.

onDestructive.$description: Text and icon color on interactive.destructive fills, must contrast at least 4.5:1.

pressed.$description: Press overlay for tap feedback on light or vivid surfaces, applied over the resting fill.

pressedInverse.$description: Press overlay for tap feedback on dark surfaces like cards on the page background, applied over the resting fill.

primaryHover.$description: Hover state of interactive.primary, for pointer hover on primary buttons.

primaryActive.$description: Pressed state of interactive.primary, the moment of click or tap.

secondaryHover.$description: Hover state of interactive.secondary, for pointer hover on secondary buttons, chips and toggles.

destructiveHover.$description: Hover state of interactive.destructive, for pointer hover on delete and remove buttons.

bold.$description: Solid success fill, use for correct-answer banners and completion states, not decorative green.

onBold.$description: Text and icon color on top of feedback.success.bold.

subtle.$description: Tinted success background, use for the panel behind a correct result.

onSubtle.$description: Text and icon color on top of feedback.success.subtle.

bold.$description: Solid error fill, use for incorrect-answer banners and failed validation summaries, not destructive buttons.

onBold.$description: Text and icon color on top of feedback.error.bold.

subtle.$description: Tinted error background, use for the panel behind a wrong result.

onSubtle.$description: Text and icon color on top of feedback.error.subtle.

bold.$description: Solid informational fill, use for neutral banners and hint callouts, not decorative blue.

onBold.$description: Text and icon color on top of feedback.info.bold.

subtle.$description: Tinted informational background, use for the panel behind an informational message.

onSubtle.$description: Text and icon color on top of feedback.info.subtle.

subtle.$description: Tinted decorative accent background, no fixed meaning (confirmed with Marilou).

bold.$description: Solid PRO fill, use for PRO badges and upgrade banners, not warnings.

heavy.$description: Used by Display L only, paired with fontFamily.display.
